title: Sitting beside Arthur C. Clarke at the 2001 premiere

tellings.quote: I end up sitting beside Arthur C. Clark in in the movie.

plain: In London in 1968, at a showing of Stanley Kubrick's new film 2001: A Space Odyssey, Whitley Strieber found himself in the seat right next to Arthur C. Clarke, the science fiction writer whose story The Sentinel the film grew out of. Strieber, a writer who says he has met alien beings, tells Michels he was there himself ("I end up sitting beside Arthur C. Clark in the movie"), and he mentions a man named Mike Smith as part of how it came about. By his account it was an early brush with the people who first imagined human contact with other minds.
